title: data list door: a blank $select answers every column and an unrecognised $count value counts — malformed values are read as the absent default
body:
`reach:` any caller of the generic list door (`GET /api/v1/data/:object`, and through the shared normalizer `POST /data/:object/query` and the runtime dispatcher). A script that builds `$select` from an empty list, or sends a mistyped `$count`, gets a 200 that looks normal: every column, and a count it may not have asked for.

## Reproduction (twice, on two fresh showcase boots at `fb91e979`, as the seed admin)

| request | answer | expected |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?$top=2&$select=title` | 200, 1 column | — |
| `…?$top=2&$select=` | 200, **all 25 columns** | 400 |
| `…?$top=2&$select=,` | 200, all 25 columns | 400 |
| `…?$top=2&select=` | 200, all 25 columns | 400 |
| `…?$top=2&$select=nope` | 400 (unknown field) | — |
| `…?$top=` | 400 (blank window) | — |
| `…?$top=2&$count=maybe` | 200, `total` reported | 400 |
| `…?$top=2&$count=false` | 200, no `total` | — |

## Mechanism

Both cases are in the list normalizer in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`:
- **Projection:** a string `fields` is `split(',').map(trim).filter(Boolean)`. A blank or comma-only value becomes `[]`, `assertProjectionFieldsExist` has nothing to refuse, and an empty projection is served as no projection.
- **Count:** the boolean step converts only the strings `'true'` and `'false'`. Any other string stays a string, so `countOptOut = options.count === false` is false and the count runs.

## Why this is a defect, in the door's own terms

- `pageWindowValue` (#25229) refuses a blank `$top` rather than reading it as absent. Its doc says: "The blank `?filter=` is absent because an empty filter and no filter mean the same thing; an empty window does not — absent means 'every row', so reading `?$top=` that way is the silent widening". An empty projection and no projection are not the same either. Absent means every column, so a blank `$select` read as absent is the same widening on the column axis.
- `assertProjectionFieldsExist` (#4226, #7532) exists because this axis "returned MORE than was asked for".
- `ODataQuerySchema.$count` is declared `z.boolean()` (`packages/spec/src/api/odata.zod.ts`).

## Done when

A blank or comma-only `$select` / `select` / `fields`, and a `$count` / `count` that is not `true` or `false`, are refused 400 with the parameter named, as `$top=` is. Pins cover both.
